title: Measurability of an upper-right region
statement: For each real number $t$, the set of points in the plane equipped with the $\ell^2$ norm whose two coordinates are both greater than $t$ is measurable.
caveat: The definition makes the upper-right region depend on $t$, but the stated theorem omits that argument; as written, its type appears not to match the set-measurability predicate.
